statement: For a year of assessment commencing on or after 1 April 2018, profits tax is chargeable on a corporation at 8.25% on the first HK$2,000,000 of assessable profits and 16.5% on the remainder under the two-tiered rates regime (Inland Revenue Ordinance Schedule 8B), against the 16.5% normal corporate rate.
caveat: Only one entity within a group of connected entities may elect the two-tiered rates for a year of assessment, unincorporated businesses use 7.5%/15% instead, and corporate partners in partnerships split the HK$2,000,000 threshold by profit-sharing ratio. Hong Kong taxes on a territorial basis: only profits arising in or derived from Hong Kong are assessable.
